title: Canonical scalar extension of an augmentation
statement: For a ring homomorphism φ:A→B and an augmentation ε:P→A[0] on the one-object bottom ring site, define the scalar augmentation of Eφ(P) by Eφ(ε), the additive-functor comparison Eφ(A[0])≅Eφ(A)[0], and multiplication B tensor_A A→B. Multiplication is the actual semilinear adjunction lift of φ. Its value on the sheafification unit of 1 tensor x is φ(ε(x)); this normalization is proved. The ring-site complexes and augmentations are those of [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data], and Eφ is [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-semilinear-extension].

proof.text: Lift the semilinear map φ on the unit modules by ringComplexSemilinearLift, apply single in degree zero, and compose with Eφ(ε). For normalization, use the degree-zero single-map equation, naturality of the tensor sheafification unit, and ringComplexSemilinearLift_one_tmul.
